blocks.text: Condo buildings in Campbell Valley
Where the condos are and what to know

items.t: Campbell Valley is a rural area of the Township of Langley, in south Langley around Campbell Valley Regional Park, close to the US border. The real estate board treats it as a sub-area of Langley; it isn't a separate municipality.
Where the condos are: there aren't any. There are no published median, price per sq ft, sale-to-list or days-on-market figures for Campbell Valley.

Anchor: Campbell Valley Regional Park is a Metro Vancouver regional park — forests, fields and wetlands, trails for walkers, cyclists and horseback riders, and a Nature House; the park is run by Metro Vancouver, not the Township.

Township SSMUH: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 6020, adopted November 18, 2024 — 3 units on lots of 280 m² or less, 4 units on lots between 280 m² and 4,050 m², lots over 4,050 m² ineligible, and the Township has no six-unit tier. Most Campbell Valley acreage parcels exceed the 4,050 m² ceiling by a wide margin, so the SSMUH framing generally does not apply to them.

Farm tax status from BC Assessment (for farmed properties): you need farm income of $2,500 on 0.8–4 ha, $2,500 plus 5% of the land value over 4 ha on larger properties, or $10,000 on under 0.8 ha. Applications are due by October 31, including for a buyer who wants to keep farm status after buying.

Pad rent (parks): where a Campbell Valley purchase involves a manufactured-home pad, pad rent is governed by the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act, not the Strata Property Act: the rent increase limit is 2.3% plus a proportional amount for 2026 and 2.2% plus a proportional amount for 2027, with 3 full months' notice and one increase per 12 months.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Campbell Valley
Fee-simple acreage parcels

items.t: A Campbell Valley parcel is fee-simple unless title shows otherwise — no strata, no Form B, no strata fees on the parcel itself; Township zoning, ALR status (where applicable) and registered charges govern. As of September 2026, Source: SnapStats.
Card zoning labels (RU1 and RU-3 in listing text) are listing copy only.

blocks.text: Where lots come up and what to know

items.t: The listings we checked are all labelled Campbell Valley, Langley, all Status: Active, Residential except one Land card, and they include a 4.38-acre equestrian property, a 0.312-acre RU1-zoned property stated in its card to be outside the ALR, a 2.32-acre estate, an 8.99-acre RU-3 property per its card, and a 9.92-acre Land card.

Campbell Valley Regional Park: Metro Vancouver's park page describes forests, fields and wetlands providing habitat for wildlife, with walkers, cyclists and horseback riders able to explore the network of trails, and a Nature House.

Market figures: in September 2026, Campbell Valley had 16 detached homes listed and none sold, and no condos or townhomes listed. The real estate board doesn't publish figures for land or farms (SnapStats, September 2026).
Township zoning: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw 1987 No. 2500 governs this area.

Small-scale multi-unit housing in the Township (Bylaw 6020, adopted November 18, 2024): 3 units on lots of 280 m² or less, 4 units on lots between 280 m² and 4,050 m², and none on lots over 4,050 m². Most Campbell Valley acreages are well over 4,050 m², so these rules generally don't apply to them. Update bylaws 6201–6203 have had only first and second reading (May 25, 2026), so Bylaw 6020 still applies.
Suites and coach houses (Township): a secondary suite can be up to 120 m². The compact lot zone (R-CL, lots of 220 to 464.5 m²) is a Willoughby rule, not a Campbell Valley one.
The area name doesn't tell you about farm status, the ALR or the park: the same Campbell Valley label covers a 9.92-acre parcel and a 0.312-acre lot described as outside the ALR. Check each property.

Campbell Valley isn't the only area with no condos or townhomes: in September 2026, Otter District also had none for sale or sold (and 2 detached homes for sale, none sold), and County Line Glen Valley had no detached homes for sale and 1 sale. Houses only is the pattern across rural Langley.

The compact lot (R-CL) numbers belong to Willoughby, not this valley: the 220 m² minimum and 464.5 m² maximum lot area are from another Township neighbourhood and don't belong in a Campbell Valley acreage valuation. There's no 355 m² figure in that zone at all.

blocks.text: What's nearby Campbell Valley
Times are from OpenStreetMap routing, November 2026.
Transit

items.t: Nearest SkyTrain station: King George Station, via Langley Centre on routes 566 and 503.
Nearest bus exchange: Langley Centre, terminus of route 566 at Bay 6.

Route 566 Campbell Valley / Langley Centre, TransLink: from Langley Centre Bay 6 via Glover Rd, 203 St, 200 St and 8 Ave to Campbell Valley Park; the timetable states weekend and holiday service runs June 8 to September 6, 2026 inclusive.
A bus stop for regular service is near the park entrance at 200th Street and 20th Avenue, and a route 566 stop is at the South Valley entrance.

blocks.text: Parks and recreation

items.t: Campbell Valley Regional Park (Metro Vancouver): forests, fields and wetlands, a network of trails and a Nature House; Little River Loop is 2.3 km return and Shaggy Mane Trail is an 11 km loop.
George Preston Recreation Centre, 20699 42 Avenue, north of the area: ice arena, hall, Langley Curling Centre.

faq.a: In September 2026, 16 detached homes were for sale and none sold, and there were no condos or townhomes for sale or sold. There's no median for the area because nothing sold that month, and medians are only published for whole communities.
faq.q: What were Campbell Valley's own market figures in September 2026?

faq.a: No. In September 2026, Otter District also had no condos or townhomes for sale or sold (and 2 detached homes for sale, none sold), and so did County Line Glen Valley (with no detached homes for sale and 1 sale).
faq.q: Are Campbell Valley's zero figures unique among Langley sub-areas?

faq.a: On ALR land, the Agricultural Land Commission allows one main house of 500 m² or less (with no more than 1,000 m² of fill), a secondary suite only inside it, and at most one additional home of up to 90 m² on properties of 40 ha or less, or 186 m² on larger ones. Local rules can be stricter.
faq.q: What residence can a Campbell Valley parcel in the ALR have?

faq.a: Neither, on the usual Campbell Valley parcel: Township Bylaw 6020 makes lots over 4,050 m² ineligible and has no 6-unit tier at all.
faq.q: Does SSMUH give my acreage 4 or 6 units?

faq.a: On ALR land, not without Agricultural Land Commission permission. Creating a strata counts as subdividing in the ALR, and homes on ALR land can't be stratified.
faq.q: A card talks about stratification potential — can an acreage become strata townhomes?

faq.a: No. In the Township, a coach house is a second home on the same fee-simple title, not a strata lot.
faq.q: Is a coach house a townhouse I can buy separately?

faq.a: Neither, on the evidence here: It is a pad on a private acreage parcel, only in a listing. It is not a manufactured-home park, not pad tenancy in a park, and not a duplex form. Confirm the specific parcel with the Township.
faq.q: The guide card mentions a mobile-home pad — is that a park or a half duplex?

faq.a: No — it is a Township of Langley sub-area in south Langley. Township bylaws, Township taxes (5% + 5% on the Township's own dates) and SD35 govern; no Mission rule applies here.
